unsupportedTerms: Checked automatically by a completion rule this list cannot describe.
untrackedOpen: This world does not check this promise automatically, so it stays open.
untrackedPast: This world does not check this promise automatically.
keptOther: An action of yours matched its completion rule.
cancelled: Cancelled. This does not mean anyone else agreed to release you.
overdueTracked: The deadline passed before the checked action happened.
